# Appendix: sensitivity of the fresh-only estimates to the self-copy detector (auto-generated by scripts/selfcopy_sensitivity.py)

A window is *copied* when a share of at least t of its K-token shingles occurs earlier in the same stream; *beyond the horizon* when it is copied and its source is not within the 600 tokens shown to the judge (share seen within the horizon below t). Primary detector: K = 12, t = 0.5. Windows: the first generated-only window after each injection (grid windows in the uninterrupted arm), Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, ten premises. Fresh-only contrasts are paired over premises (exact sign-flip permutation, bootstrap 95% CI over premises).
